name: Hrádek nad Nisou (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part bearing a white fleur-de-lis and a white lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 18 April 2014 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
